newsitem.title: USA: AMEX says reviewing Equisure listing.
newsitem.headline: AMEX says reviewing Equisure listing.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange said Friday it began formal proceedings that could eventually lead to a delisting of shares in Equisure Inc.

"This morning, the exchange initiated formal proceedings to review the continued listing eligibility of Equisure," an exchange spokeswoman said, adding the review may result in a decision to begin delisting proceedings.
The American Stock Exchange declined to comment on specific reasons for the Equisure review, but earlier today, Equisure issued its own statement regarding the ongoing trading halt in its shares.

In the statement, Equisure said its board believed the suspension resulted from allegations of improper trading activity by affiliates of Equisure, allegations the board "categorically and emphatically" denied.
Any delisting, by the AMEX's own rules, would be preceded by a formal written notification and a conference between exchange and company representatives.
